findings.title: Completion observers execute before charge approval
findings.closure: Make descriptor-aware charge the sole pre-approval callback and observe only after target completion.

findings.title: Exact proofs certify fixed labels instead of captured behavior
findings.closure: Derive every exact result and scoped count from structured production-path traces.

findings.title: Direct-site mutations alter shared helpers instead of one call site
findings.closure: Execute a target-hoist-and-cache mutation at each of the seven direct production sites.

findings.title: Mutation transcripts omit the property-producing subprocess
findings.closure: Record replayable compile and isolated-root property commands and exact outcomes separately.

findings.title: Rust descriptor phase and applicability disagree with evidence vocabulary
findings.closure: Normalize runtime descriptors to projection_construction and required.

findings.title: Whole-trace counts can attribute earlier work to a later requested site
findings.closure: Scope counts to the requested site or the suffix beginning at its failed charge attempt.

findings.title: Independent exact proofs probe a shared helper instead of production paths
findings.closure: Instrument actual production execution and classify helper probes as supplemental only.

findings.title: External assurance and publication authority remain held
findings.closure: Preserve the hold; local work cannot close it.
